name: Witch's Broom
note: Halloween 2026 (lane Cues B, docs/prompts/HW_CUES_B_PROMPT.md 2.4, concept C3b_broom.png), remade 2026-10-28 (Justin 12:55): a real broom, a gnarled twisted branch with knots and a broken stub, a violet crystal tip with a silver coil, a thick purple binding with a silver buckle and gold crescent, a big full head of golden straw (3.3x), a swaying witch-hat charm; moons, stars, bats and spell stars round it, potion smoke and bats out of the bristles, sparks from the crystal. No ribbons.

vfx.Piece: pieces/witch_broom_aura: the concept's glowing ribbons as a 3D decor piece round the whole handle, the Firework's way: two narrow saturated Neon strips (violet #8B30FF, emerald #19E088, 0.09 wide, 0.2 off the bark, a turn every 1.8 studs) turning like screws in opposite senses with a Glow breath toward a lighter tint of their own hue; a thin gold sparkle thread the other way, twinkling; three gold crescent moons, five four-point stars and two flapping bats orbiting the handle. Second build (designer, 2026-10-28 11:55); the wide pale bands and the Glow toward white of the first retune bloomed into a white sheet in daylight and are gone.

Moving.Note: The moons, stars, bats and spell stars (the aura piece), the two orbiters and the halo beam move; the crystal glows 0.25-1.0 over 2.4 s; the charm swings over 1.8 s; the bristle head flexes over 2.6 and 4 s.

Aura.Note: Secret (brief 2.4), third build (Justin 12:55: no ribbons, the Broom's own effects), inside out: a deep violet haze body, a violet additive glow, emerald wisps, violet motes, star and gold glints, crescent flecks along the handle; at the bristle head potion smoke curling up out of the straw (teal to violet), potion bubbles rising, straw leaves flying off and bats bursting out of it; sparks and a flare spraying from the crystal; a sparkle trickle from the hat charm; spell pops (four star pops, sparks; no rings); one violet halo beam; a violet PointLight at the crystal, an emerald one mid-handle and a gold one at the binding; two sparkle heads riding the cue; violet outline. About 169 particles a second before BackRateScale (budget 170).

Trail.Note: Stars, crescents, straw leaves and a few bats riding the ball behind a violet-emerald ribbon with a white-violet core.

Pocket.Note: Secret, about 2.2 s: a violet flash; the portal piece (two Neon rings turning opposite ways, a ForceField disc, crescents and stars riding them) rises and widens over the pocket with a swirl disc lying flat in it; a dark column behind a column of sparkles and crescents; then the witch over the moon (a 4x4 OneShot flipbook, 4.5 studs, 3 studs up: the moon fades in, the witch crosses with two bats, it fades); a gold star burst at the moon; bats; violet and emerald ring decals on the cloth; motes raining down to close.

Sound.Note: Roblox library: Pro Sound Effects "Magic Whooshes Growly Magic Whooshes Airy Gusts 7" (1.6 s), free, no upload; PreloadAsync Success 2026-10-28

Budget.Note: Third build (2026-10-28, 13:15): the remade broom body (6 parts, 9,600 triangles: gnarled handle, 3.3x straw head) and the aura piece without ribbons (19 parts, 2,392 triangles: moons, stars, bats, three spell stars).
